description: 休日の明るいスーパーマーケットで、父親と2人の子どもが夕食の材料を買っている。中央では父親がスマートフォンの買い物リストを確認しながら、ショッピングカートの中の商品と見比べている。左側では高校生の娘が野菜売り場で2種類のトマトを手に持ち、品質や値段を比較している。右側では中学生の息子が冷蔵棚から牛乳を取り出し、ショッピングカートに入れようとしている。カートにはパン、卵、パスタ、野菜などが入り、周囲には果物、野菜、乳製品、価格表示などが整理されている。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly three people shopping together inside a bright, clean, modern Japanese supermarket: one father, one teenage daughter, and one teenage or middle-school-aged son. Do not include any additional visible customers or employees. The atmosphere should be ordinary, positive, practical, organized, and easy to understand. In the center foreground, the father is standing beside a shopping cart and checking a grocery list on his smartphone. He is comparing the list with the groceries already inside the cart. The cart should clearly contain bread, eggs, pasta, carrots, lettuce, onions, and several other dinner ingredients. On the left side, the teenage daughter is standing in the fresh produce section. She is holding two different packs or types of tomatoes, one in each hand, and carefully comparing their appearance and price labels before deciding which one to buy. She should look thoughtful and focused. On the right side, the son is standing beside a refrigerated dairy shelf. He is taking a carton of milk from the shelf and reaching toward the family shopping cart as if he is about to place it inside. Make the three actions visually distinct and easy to describe: the father checking the shopping list, the daughter comparing tomatoes, and the son selecting milk. Include organized displays of vegetables, fruit, milk, yogurt, eggs, bread, pasta, reusable shopping bags, price tags with simple numbers but no important readable text, shopping cart, smartphone, and supermarket aisle signs using simple icons. The store should look spacious and realistic without appearing crowded. Exactly three visible people. No additional people, no animals, no speech bubbles, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, highly detailed but uncluttered, expressive natural body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.

sentences.text: The family is shopping for ingredients to prepare dinner.
sentences.ja: 家族は夕食を作るための材料を買っています。

sentences.text: The father is checking a grocery list on his smartphone.
sentences.ja: 父親はスマートフォンで食料品リストを確認しています。

sentences.text: He is comparing the list with the items already in the shopping cart.
sentences.ja: 彼はリストとすでにカートに入っている商品を見比べています。

sentences.text: The daughter is comparing two different kinds of tomatoes.
sentences.ja: 娘は2種類のトマトを比較しています。

sentences.text: She appears to be checking both their quality and price.
sentences.grammar: appear to be / both A and B
sentences.ja: 彼女は品質と値段の両方を確認しているようです。

sentences.text: The boy is taking a carton of milk from the refrigerated shelf.
sentences.ja: 男の子は冷蔵棚から牛乳パックを取っています。

sentences.text: He is about to put the milk into the family shopping cart.
sentences.ja: 彼は牛乳を家族のショッピングカートに入れようとしています。

sentences.text: The three family members seem to be sharing the shopping tasks.
sentences.ja: 3人の家族は買い物の役割を分担しているようです。

sentences.text: The three family members are purchasing groceries in preparation for an evening meal.
sentences.ja: 3人の家族は夕食の準備として食料品を購入しています。

sentences.text: The father is methodically verifying the shopping list against the items already placed in the cart.
sentences.ja: 父親は買い物リストとすでにカートへ入れた商品を手順立てて照合しています。

sentences.text: He appears to be assessing which household necessities still need to be purchased.
sentences.grammar: appear to be＋現在分詞 / 間接疑問
sentences.ja: 彼はまだ購入する必要がある家庭用品が何か確認しているようです。

sentences.text: His daughter is carefully comparing two varieties of tomatoes in terms of both quality and price.
sentences.grammar: in terms of / both A and B
sentences.ja: 娘は2種類のトマトを品質と価格の両面から注意深く比較しています。

sentences.text: Her behavior suggests that she is making a considered choice rather than simply selecting the first product available.
sentences.ja: 彼女の行動から、最初に目についた商品を選ぶのではなく、よく考えて選択していることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the son is retrieving a carton of milk from the refrigerated section and preparing to place it in the cart.
sentences.ja: その一方で、息子は冷蔵コーナーから牛乳を取り出し、カートへ入れようとしています。

sentences.text: The selection of vegetables, eggs, bread, pasta, and dairy products suggests that the family is planning a reasonably balanced meal.
sentences.ja: 野菜、卵、パン、パスタ、乳製品を選んでいることから、家族が比較的バランスのよい食事を計画していることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: Each person is handling a different part of the task, indicating that the household responsibilities are being shared.
sentences.grammar: 分詞構文 / 現在進行受動態
sentences.ja: それぞれが異なる作業を担当しており、家庭内の役割が分担されていることが分かります。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how an ordinary shopping trip can involve planning, comparison, decision-making, and cooperation.
sentences.ja: この場面は、日常的な買い物にも計画、比較、意思決定、協力が含まれることを示しています。
